teaser.en: Its Digo name says the wood cracks easily; its seeds shine like blue-black metal.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linasema mbao zake hupasuka kwa urahisi; mbegu zake hung'aa kama chuma cha rangi ya buluu-nyeusi.

summary.en: Mpalika is a widespread African forest tree whose small capsules open to show shiny, metallic blue-black seeds. The Digo name says its wood cracks easily.
summary.sw: Mpalika ni mti wa misitu ulioenea kote Afrika ambao vifuko vyake vidogo hufunguka na kuonyesha mbegu zinazong'aa za rangi ya buluu-nyeusi kama chuma. Jina la Kidigo linasema mbao zake hupasuka kwa urahisi.

about.en:
*Mpalika* is a deciduous tree that can reach 25 metres, though in some places it grows as a shrub. Its branches droop, and on young trees they stand out at right angles to the trunk. The bark is thin and grey-brown, and becomes rough and flaking with age. The leaves are simple, thin and oval, about 10 cm long. Held up to the light, each leaf shows a clear, see-through edge.

Male and female flowers grow on separate trees. They are tiny, green-yellow and fragrant, and appear while the tree is bare. The fruit is a small three-part capsule that splits to release three shiny, metallic blue-black seeds.
about.sw:
*Mpalika* ni mti unaopukutisha majani unaoweza kufikia urefu wa mita 25, ingawa katika maeneo mengine hukua kama kichaka. Matawi yake huinama, na kwenye miti michanga hutokeza kwa pembe mraba kutoka kwenye shina. Gome ni jembamba na la rangi ya kijivu-hudhurungi, na huwa gumu na kubanduka kadiri mti unavyozeeka. Majani ni sahili, membamba na ya duaradufu, yenye urefu wa takriban sm 10. Ukiliinua jani kuelekea mwangaza, kila jani huonyesha ukingo ulio wazi unaopenyeza mwanga.

Maua ya kiume na ya kike huota kwenye miti tofauti. Ni madogo sana, ya rangi ya kijani-manjano na yenye harufu nzuri, na huchanua wakati mti hauna majani. Tunda ni kifuko kidogo chenye sehemu tatu kinachopasuka na kuachia mbegu tatu zinazong'aa za rangi ya buluu-nyeusi kama chuma.

where.en: It is found across Africa, from Senegal to Sudan and south to South Africa. In Kenya it grows from the coast to the west of the country, in moist and dry forest margins and forest remnants, and is often an early coloniser of lowland forest.
where.sw: Unapatikana kote Afrika, kuanzia Senegal hadi Sudan na kusini hadi Afrika Kusini. Nchini Kenya unaota kuanzia pwani hadi magharibi mwa nchi, pembezoni mwa misitu yenye unyevu na mikavu na katika mabaki ya misitu, na mara nyingi ni miongoni mwa miti ya kwanza kuota katika misitu ya nyanda za chini.

uses.en: ICRAF records it as firewood, charcoal, poles, timber for cabinet work and root medicine. Coppice shoots make good building poles.
uses.sw: ICRAF inaandika kuwa hutumika kwa kuni, mkaa, nguzo, mbao za kutengenezea kabati na samani, na dawa ya mizizi. Machipukizi yanayoota baada ya kukatwa hufanya nguzo nzuri za ujenzi.

names.en: *Mpalika* means 'cracks': Pakia records that the wood is said to crack (*palika*) easily. ICRAF, by contrast, describes the timber as hard and heavy. In Swahili it is *mjangari*, and in Giriama *mukololo*. Pakia gives no English name.
names.sw: *Mpalika* maana yake ni 'hupasuka': Pakia anaandika kwamba inasemekana mbao zake hupasuka (*palika*) kwa urahisi. ICRAF, kinyume chake, inaeleza mbao zake kuwa ngumu na nzito. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mjangari*, na kwa Kigiriama *mukololo*. Pakia hatoi jina la Kiingereza.

reason.en: Bridelia micrantha, a forest tree of the same family
reason.sw: Bridelia micrantha, mti wa msituni wa familia ileile

reason.en: Another fast-colonising tree named for a property
reason.sw: Mti mwingine unaoota haraka katika ardhi mpya, uliopewa jina kutokana na sifa yake
